evals.prompt: Design a logo for this project. The README describes fastbuild, a CLI build tool for developers.
evals.expected_output: Project analysis summarized, a style proposed and confirmed, wordmark casing confirmed, then 7 SVGs written to /assets/logo/ with logo-mark.svg first, geometry verified by reading back the variants, brand-showcase.html generated, and a Final Report.
expectations: Summarized the detected product identity (name, type, purpose, audience, existing colors) before designing
Confirmed the style selection and the wordmark casing with the user before generating any text-bearing SVG
Wrote logo-mark.svg first and derived the 6 sibling variants from its exact path data
Read back the mark, full, icon, white and black variants and verified the d="" strings are identical or correctly scaled via transform
Every SVG has a correct viewBox and contains no embedded rasters; favicon.svg is a simplified 2-layer mark at 16x16
The Final Report opens with a Result: line carrying COMPLETE and the files written
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence names the geometry read-back and the svg-reviewer result, and Uncertainty labels each assumption as an assumption
The Final Report's Decision: line names the pending choice or says No approval needed

evals.prompt: Our brand colors are teal #0D9488 and amber #F59E0B. Create the logo suite for our SaaS dashboard, wordmark as "Acornly" in title case.
evals.expected_output: The detected brand colors are used instead of the default dark/neon-green palette, the casing answer is accepted without re-asking, and the full 7-SVG suite plus showcase page is delivered with a Final Report.
expectations: Used teal #0D9488 and amber #F59E0B instead of the default dark base plus neon-green palette
Confirmed the detected brand colors with the user before proceeding, or noted the user's message as that confirmation
Did not ask again about wordmark casing, because the user already specified title case
Monochrome variants differ from logo-full.svg only in color, not geometry
The Final Report opens with Result: and its status, and its Evidence: line cites only checks that ran

evals.name: no-project-context
evals.expected_output: The skill finds no project context and asks for the product name, product type, and one-sentence purpose before generating anything.
expectations: Checked README.md, package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml and go.mod for product identity
Asked for the product name, product type, and one-sentence purpose
Wrote no SVG file before the user answered
If the run ends without an answer, the Final Report status is BLOCKED and the Decision: line names the missing information

evals.name: geometry-divergence
evals.prompt: Design a logo for my notes app. After generating, the icon variant's paths don't match the mark.
evals.expected_output: The Phase 3 verification catches the divergence: the variants are read back, the d="" strings are diffed, and the icon is fixed from the canonical mark's path data before the run finishes.
expectations: Read back the mark, full, icon, white and black variants and compared the d="" strings
Re-derived the diverging variant from logo-mark.svg's exact path data instead of paraphrasing the shape
Did not declare the run finished while a variant's geometry diverged
If the divergence is still unresolved at the end, the Final Report status is PARTIAL and names the failing file

evals.name: casing-not-specified
evals.prompt: Generate the full logo set for DataPipe, our ETL CLI.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks explicitly how the product name should be cased in the wordmark before generating any text-bearing SVG.
expectations: Asked for the wordmark casing before generating logo-full.svg or logo-wordmark.svg
Generated no text-bearing SVG before the casing answer
A text-free asset such as the mark may proceed only if the style confirmation gate was also satisfied

evals.prompt: Draw a detailed illustration of a forest cabin for our blog post header.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger: illustrations are named in the negative-trigger clause.
expectations: logo-designer did not trigger
No SVG logo variants or brand-showcase.html were produced

evals.prompt: We need full brand guidelines: voice and tone, typography scale, spacing system, and usage rules.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger: full brand guidelines are named in the negative-trigger clause.
expectations: logo-designer did not trigger
No /assets/logo/ directory was created
